name: Hotaru Rinne
source:
Likes: Kotatsus
Dislikes: Getting lost

A fellow Elfin who came to Tsukigasaki along with [url=/c24584]Riku[/url] and [url=/c17995]Hinata[/url]. She grew up in the same orphanage as Riku. She often tries to act older, to counteract her child-like appearance which very much bothers her. Despite her being the age where she should be going to school, she chooses to work at the kindergarten in Tsukigasaki.

[spoiler]She is [url=/c24584]Riku[/url]'s half-sister. [/spoiler]
